title: MS60054: Introduction To Biomaterials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisite: None
Introduction to biomaterials; characterization of materials mechanical
properties; thermal properties; surface properties and adhesion; the structure
of solids classes and forms of biomaterials – metals, ceramics, synthetic
polymers, composites, hydrogels; bioresorbable and biodegradable materials;
natural materials, structure and properties relationships of biological
materials; Foreign biomaterials – biological interface and reactions;
biological response to implants; Polymer directed self-assembly of inorganic
biomaterials – Biomimetics; Autografts, allografts and xenografts, composites,
surface modification, 2D and 3D scaffolds for tissue engineering; Materials for
artificial blood vessels, mechanical heart valves, breast implants, orthopedic
joints, dental fillings, chin augmentation, devices such as intravenous
catheters and drug delivery vehicles, intra-ocular lenses, burn dressings,
sutures, biomaterials for soft tissue replacement; biomaterials for hard tissue
replacement; biologically functional biomaterials;,testing and clearance of
biomaterials; evaluation of biomaterials.
